title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - January 20, 2026

### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - January 20, 2026

#### General Bug Fix

* Resolved an issue with Brigitte that caused her to lose her abilities under certain conditions

#### Stadium Bug Fix

* Increased spawn defense turret damage from 25% to 50%
note_cn:

#### 综合错误修复

* 修复了布丽吉塔在特定情况下会失去技能的问题

#### 角斗领域错误修复

* 重生室防御炮台的伤害从25%提高至50%
